Spacious and modern 3-bedroom apartment in Park Field Tower 2, located in the heart of Dubai Hills Estate. Offering a well-balanced layout and contemporary finishes, this residence is ideal for families seeking comfort, space, and connectivity.

3 Bedrooms
4 Bathrooms
BUA: 1,426 sq. ft.
Open-plan living and dining area
Modern kitchen with sleek cabinetry
Built-in wardrobes
Floor-to-ceiling windows with natural light

Community Features:

Swimming pool
Fully equipped gym
Landscaped gardens
Children’s play area
24/7 security

Situated moments from Dubai Hills Mall, parks, schools, and major road links, this apartment offers a refined lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most desirable master communities.
